evidence.title: Vibecoding. - by Ruben Hassid - How to AI

name: Vibecoding.
summary: Guide to vibecoding with Claude Code for non-coders: setup, a copy-paste mega prompt, costs, a best-of prompt list and when not to use it.
description: A How to AI post explaining vibecoding, building a site by talking to an AI in plain English, and how to set up Claude Code. It includes a mega prompt to copy, notes on making output less generic, a cost breakdown, a best-of prompt list and a step on handing the project to a real coder.
